name: Hypnotic Pattern

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: 30-foot cube; WIS saves only for creatures that see pattern; failed targets Charmed, Incapacitated and Speed 0; damage or another creature shake action ends for exact target.

rules.text: You create a twisting pattern of colors in a 30-foot Cube within range.
The pattern appears for a moment and vanishes.
Each creature in the area who can see the pattern must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration.
While Charmed, the creature has the Incapacitated condition and a Speed of 0.
The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.
